title: Support draft uses start_raw without output_schema and parses the last valid JSON object
answers: why does the support draft not use output_schema
draft poll fails with no agent message
AI reply used example JSON instead of the real answer
where is the support draft JSON parsed
body:
The draft call in draft.py:_draft_async uses MultiTurnSession.start_raw and does not pass output_schema. With a schema set, storing the output completes the task run before an agent message reaches the log, so the poll fails with "no agent message". Do not restore output_schema on this call. A Greptile request to restore it was declined for this reason. The five one-shot model calls still keep their JSON schemas.
Parsing happens in draft.py:_parse_draft. It scans every '{' with json.JSONDecoder.raw_decode and returns the LAST dict that validates as SupportReplyDraft, so example or ticket JSON earlier in the text is skipped. The 0–1 confidence coercion (from #105049) still guards bad scores.
If the first turn has no draft, draft.py:_draft_from_session sends one follow-up (_DRAFT_JSON_NUDGE) through send_followup_raw with max_poll_seconds=_DRAFT_NUDGE_POLL_SECONDS (90). The first poll plus the nudge polls must fit inside the activity's 20-minute start_to_close_timeout. EmptyAgentTurnError from start_raw means the run is already ended, so there is nothing to nudge.
Convention: keep nudge and salvage logic in products/conversations. Do not change the shared products/tasks runner, because that would change runner behavior for other callers.
applies: Support reply draft agent call and its output parsing in products/conversations
